retirement_age.notes: Public pension regime (RPM) ages are 62 for men and 57 for women; statutory is set to the higher value. The 2024 pension reform (Law 2381) was upheld by the Constitutional Court in August 2026 and keeps these ages; it is scheduled to take effect in April 2027. Only Congress can change the ages; a debate on equalising them was reported in late September 2026 but no change has been set. The private savings regime (RAIS) has no minimum age.
